about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Anderson County Schools
channels.legal_basis: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 0400-40-05-.07(2)(o) (a term of every NPDES permit): "In the case of any noncompliance, or any release (whether or not caused by improper operation and maintenance), which could cause a threat to human health or the environment, the permittee shall: 1. Report the noncompliance or release to the Commissioner within 24 hours from the time the permittee becomes aware of the circumstances. ... 2. Submit a written report within five days"; NPDES permit TN0057860
channels.note: Anderson County Schools reports each release that could threaten health or the environment to TDEC within 24 hours and in writing within five days through MyTDEC Forms; TDEC publishes the report in its Events Report about five days after the event, read by the tn-tdec-events-report feed, whose host has refused this site's client since 2026-11-07 (the tn-tdec-events-report row).
